allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Shilpa Medicare Limited has informed the Exchange that the Securities IssueCommittee of the Board of Directors of Shilpa Medicare Limited has, at its meeting held todayi.e., October 06, 2025, accorded approval for the allotment of 9,77,90,908 Equity Shares of ₹1/- each as fully paid-up Bonus Equity Shares in the ratio of 1:1  to the shareholders of the Company as on the Record Date, i.e., October 03, 2025.
